projections.source_time_basis: HYCOM instantaneous2022January/July15T00Z;not monthly means or seasonal envelopes.
projections.projection_gate: Interior full-section surface-connected integral maximum and resolved declared primary lower contour;selected model columns do not independently validate named-current axes.
projections.branch_scope: Partial Malvinas/Falkland Argentine-margin49–41S reach upstream of the Brazil–Malvinas confluence. Inshore/main branches,detached along-slope cores and eddies can compete inside broad gates; the selected integral maximum does not independently assign a coherent main branch. Northward component is a fixed diagnostic rather than a locally rotated along-slope vector. Exclude upstream Drake/Burdwood ACC partition,Brazil Current,confluence recirculation and detached eddies as target identities. Frey2021 local core depths,nominal700m instrument range and Cainzos2023 inverse transport-layer extent remain distinct observations/definitions,not imposed bottoms or validation of these2022 snapshots.
projections.interpolation_assumption: Keep every original fixed-longitude section in declared downstream order. Use selected native model positions;where no column qualifies,use actualnativewrappedlongitude and the declaredlatitude-gate midpoint only as an explicit unresolved reference geometry placeholder with no sampled position or depth. ShortestWGS84legs connect adjacentoriginal references,including across180/-180. Assume linear lowerdepth and paired modelspan only between neighboring original supported nodes;never skip,extrapolate or fill from an alternate cutoff. Distances are reference geometry,not measured current lengths.

projections.projection_gate: Interior full-section surface-connected integral maximum and resolved declared primary lower contour;selected model columns do not independently validate named-current axes.
projections.branch_scope: Partial East African coast10–4S reach within the source-described perennial northward11–3S band,with38.5–43.5E searches. Exclude northern seasonal Somali/EACC confluence and countercurrent,Madagascar boundary current,Mozambique Channel and detached eddies as target identities. Geographic maxima do not independently establish an EACC axis or source-water identity; islands/coastal missing support can censor selection. Swallow1991 upper500dbar transport and Zheng2024 regional upper300m concentration/analysis domain are different source quantities,not current bottoms,uniform thickness or annual extrema.
